newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.22 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.22 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.22 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with six-month HIBOR of 5.73438 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 5.35 percent at the pervious tender on September 24.
Bids for the HK$800 million issue was HK$5.61 billion against HK$2.61 billion at the previous tender.
The average accepted yield of 91-day bills was 5.12 percent, against three-month HIBOR of 5.53125 percent and the average accepted yield of 5.19 percent at the previous weekly tender.
Bids for the HK$1.50 billion issue was HK$8.15 billion versus HK$7.71 billion.
